name: Villainess Liberty
source:
Thrown into a world that doesn’t know who you are but thinks it does.  

They don’t see you.  

They see someone else.  

Someone they fear.  

Someone they executed.  

To survive, you must become the person they fear.

[From [url=https://frosty-free.itch.io/villainess-liberty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被骤然抛入一个根本不认识你、却自以为早已将你看透的世界。

他们眼中所见的并非真正的你。

他们看到的是另一个人。

一个令他们闻风丧胆的人。

一个曾被他们亲手处决的人。

为了活下去，你必须成为那个令他们恐惧的存在。

[摘自[url=https://frosty-free.itch.io/villainess-liberty]itch.io[/url]]
